whyItMatters: A JWT accepted without signature verification lets anyone forge tokens and authenticate as any user, because the token content alone is trusted.
actions: Pass an explicit algorithms allowlist and keep verify_signature enabled.
Validate issuer, audience, and expiry claims on every decode.
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm every flagged decode site enforces verification.
verification: Every jwt.decode site verifies signature and claims before trusting the token.
